questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

He studies the subject known as __the scientific study of insects.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Entomology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Entomology"** is the branch of zoology concerned with the study of insects. It involves researching their development, anatomy, physiology, behavior, distribution, ecology, and classification. (कीट विज्ञान)

 
 
• **Example: **Entomologists may study the role of insects in spreading diseases or their importance in pollination.
 
 
 
• Hence, the scientific study of insects is known as **'Entomology'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Entomology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Alchemy **(रसायन विद्या): An early form of chemistry, with philosophic and magical associations, aimed at the transmutation of base metals into gold, the discovery of a universal cure for disease, and the discovery of a means of indefinitely prolonging life.

 
 
• **Example:** Alchemy is often considered the precursor to the modern science of chemistry.
 
 
 
• **Etymology **(शब्द उत्पत्ति विज्ञान): The study of the origin of words and the way in which their meanings have changed throughout history.
 
 
• **Example: **Understanding the etymology of words can provide insight into the history and evolution of a language.
 
 
 
• The subject "Biology" is a natural science concerned with the study of life and living organisms, including their structure, function, growth, evolution, distribution, and taxonomy. (जीव विज्ञान)
 
 
• Example: Studying biology helps us understand the living world and the ways its many species (including humans) function, evolve, and interact.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

Harish told me / in the morning / that Gaurav will / come the next day.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is:** that Gaurav will**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the sentence, the verb form **"will come"** is used incorrectly in the context of indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is in the **past tense** as indicated by **"Harish told me".**
 
• When reporting speech in the past, the verb tense usually shifts back. Therefore, **"will"** should change to **"would"**.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"that Gaurav would come the next day"** to maintain consistency with the tense used in the reported speech.
 
• Therefore, the error is in the segment "that Gaurav will".

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Harish told me in the morning that Gaurav **would** come the next day*.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Cup of tea
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Something one likes/excels in**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Cup of tea"** is often used in English to describe something that one finds particularly enjoyable or that one is particularly good at. It is not related to the literal act of drinking tea but is a metaphorical expression. (पसंद)

 
 
• **Example: **Rock climbing really isn't my cup of tea; I prefer hiking.
 
 
 
• The phrase **"Something one likes/excels in"** perfectly encapsulates the essence of the idiom 'Cup of tea', indicating a preference or an area of expertise. (पसंद करना/में उत्कृष्ट होना)
 
 
• **Example: **Puzzle games are really my cup of tea; I love the challenge they present.
 
 
 
• Thus, the idiom 'Cup of tea' is best explained by **Option 4**, which signifies personal preference or skill.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Something one likes/excels in.**

• **Example: **During the meeting, Jenna decided to play devil's advocate to ensure all sides of the argument were explored.

• **Example: **He often plays devil's advocate in discussions, not because he disagrees, but to ensure a thorough examination of the topic.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the phrase **'play devil’s advocate'** is most appropriately defined by **'Option 3'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Butterfly was __attracted__ towards the bright flowers.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Repulsed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in the sentence is **"attracted,"** which means to draw someone or something towards them, typically by the appeal or charm or due to some specific qualities (आकर्षित in Hindi).

 
 
• Example: "The magnet attracted the iron filings, drawing them towards it."
 
 
 
• The antonym of "attracted" is **"repulsed,"** which means to drive back or to ward off; in this context, it refers to a strong dislike or distaste that drives someone or something away (विकर्षित in Hindi).
 
 
• Example: "The bitter taste of the medicine repulsed him, making it hard to swallow."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Repulsed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meanings of the rest of the options are given below: 
 
 
• **Reckoned**: This means to consider or think of someone or something in a specified way (माना जाता है in Hindi).
 
• **Reargued**: There is no standard term "reargued" widely recognized in English dictionaries. It suggests the idea of arguing again, which is not contextually relevant here.
 
• **Recurred**: This means to occur again, periodically, or repeatedly (फिर से होना in Hindi).
